deleteConfirm.message: This removes your avatar. It goes back to showing your initial.

profile.help: You can use your own generated or uploaded images as your avatar (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB). You can choose the area to crop.

display.intro: Changes on this page take effect immediately. Except for the rating mask, they are stored only in this browser.

faviconProgress.label: Show progress in the tab icon
faviconProgress.help: Shows the run status in the browser tab icon while a run is queued or running. Turning this off does not change the animated logo in the app bar.

studioLayout.label: Studio layout
studioLayout.help: On narrow screens (under 768px) the input pane always sits below the result. You can also switch from the button at the top right of the result area.

stockShowSketchMask.label: Show sketches, masks, arrangements, and regions in Stock
stockShowSketchMask.help: When off, you can open them from the lineage graph and the run details.

tagCompletion.label: Tag completion in prompts
tagCompletion.help: Suggests tags for the word at the cursor while you write a prompt as text. The tag-mode input always shows suggestions regardless of this setting.
tagCompletion.optionTagProviders: Only for SD WebUI and ComfyUI (default)

tagTranslations.label: Show Japanese translations of tags
tagTranslations.help: Shows the translation from the tag dictionary next to tag suggestions and chips. Only shown when the display language is Japanese.

contentRatingMask.heading: Rating mask
contentRatingMask.help: Images at the chosen levels are blurred in lists and the viewer. Click one to show just that image. This only changes how images look; it does not restrict access to them.

browserStorage.heading: Settings stored in this browser
browserStorage.label: Reset this browser's settings to defaults
browserStorage.help: The settings on this page, panel sizes and open/closed states, map values, the generation form draft and similar are stored only in this browser. Clearing them restores the defaults.
browserStorage.confirmMessage:
This clears all GAKEI settings stored in this browser and reloads the page.

Cleared: display language (falls back to the browser's language), tab icon progress, generation screen layout and input size, sidebar width and open panel, open/closed states in the stock and the viewer, map values (tab, neighbors, limit, threshold, lineage edges), sketch pen, seed mode, prompt tag completion and tag translations, and the last selected group.

Settings stored on the server, images, history and your login are not affected.
browserStorage.confirmWarning: The unsent prompt, parameters and input images in the generation form will also be cleared.

accessTokens.intro: Used to connect AI agents to GAKEI over MCP. A token acts with your permissions, so do not share it with anyone.
accessTokens.nameTooltip: A name that tells you which agent or PC uses it (up to 100 characters).
accessTokens.namePlaceholder: e.g. Claude Code on my PC
accessTokens.expiryTooltip: An expired token can no longer be used. The expiry cannot be extended later; issue a new token instead.
accessTokens.scopeTooltip: A read-only token can only search, view and download images and runs.
accessTokens.scopeHelp: Read-only tokens can only search, view and download. They cannot generate images, upload, or change groups.
accessTokens.createdWarning: This value is shown only now. It cannot be shown again after you leave this page.
accessTokens.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

revokeConfirm.message: Revoke the token "{name}"? Agents using it will no longer be able to connect. This cannot be undone.

apiKey.heading: API key
apiKey.loadFailed: Could not load the key status. If the server was just updated, try restarting it.
apiKey.envLocked: The environment variable (.env) value takes priority, so it cannot be changed here.
apiKey.notRequired: The current provider does not use an API key (it returns a dummy image for testing). You can still add or remove a key here.
apiKey.helpTextBefore: A key you save here is stored in this PC's data directory (secrets.json). You can get one from

deleteConfirm.message: This deletes the saved API key.

baseUrl.heading: Base URL
baseUrl.loadFailed: Could not load the base URL status. If the server was just updated, try restarting it.
baseUrl.envLocked: The environment variable (.env) value takes priority, so it cannot be changed here.
baseUrl.helpText: Set this to use an OpenAI-compatible proxy such as LiteLLM. GAKEI sends its model names as-is, so the proxy must offer the same model names. Prices shown are still OpenAI's list prices.
baseUrl.clearedToast: Base URL reset to the default (OpenAI directly).

clearConfirm.message: This deletes the saved base URL and resets it to OpenAI directly.

baseUrl.verifyHelp: Before registering, GAKEI connects to this URL to check that it works (this can take about 15 seconds). To go back to OpenAI itself, use "Reset to default".
baseUrl.keyRequiredHelp: The connection's origin (scheme, host and port) changes, so the saved API key is not sent. Enter the API key to use with the new connection. It is verified with this key and registered together with the connection.
baseUrl.envKeyOriginLocked: The API key comes from the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable (.env), so a connection with a different origin (scheme, host and port) cannot be registered from the screen. Set OPENAI_BASE_URL in .env instead.

apiKey.verifyHelp: Before registering, GAKEI connects to OpenAI to check that the key works (this can take about 15 seconds).

general.envNote: Using the environment variable (.env) value. Saving here makes the screen setting take priority from now on.

moderation.label: moderation
moderation.help: Applies only to generation without input images (Generate API); it has no effect on editing (Edit). low is less restrictive than auto, and auto is OpenAI's standard filtering.

general.resetPending: Saving will reset this to the default ({default}).

llmConnections.intro: Where LLM and VLM (models that read images) requests are sent. Features that use an LLM, such as auto titles and tags, choose from the endpoints registered here. You can register OpenAI-compatible servers such as Ollama, LM Studio, or LiteLLM.
llmConnections.loadFailed: Could not load the LLM connections.
llmConnections.builtinHelp: Uses the name, Base URL, and key from the OpenAI settings. Only the API style, connection type, and structured outputs can be changed.
llmConnections.apiStyleHelp: Choose Chat Completions if the server does not support the Responses API.
llmConnections.apiKeyNotSet: Not set (a dummy key is sent)

deleteConfirm.message: Deletes the endpoint “{name}” and its saved key.

llmConnections.limitReached: You can register up to {max} endpoints.
llmConnections.baseUrlInvalid: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://
llmConnections.apiKeyOptionalHelp: Optional. Leave empty for servers that need no key (a dummy key is sent).

apiKeyDeleteConfirm.message: Deletes the key for the endpoint “{name}”. A dummy key will be sent instead.

llmConnections.deleteDisabledInUse: Cannot be deleted while a feature uses it.
llmConnections.apiKeyRequiredHelp: The Base URL's origin (scheme, host and port) changes, so the saved key is not sent. Enter the key to use with the new connection (if it needs no key, delete the key first).
llmConnections.structuredOutputsHelp: Whether the server supports responses constrained by a JSON schema (Structured Outputs). Region detection and ComfyUI workflow suggestions need it. GAKEI does not ask the server, so "Auto" treats only the official OpenAI endpoint as supported. Choose "Supported" when, for example, you reach OpenAI models through an OpenAI-compatible proxy.

annotation.intro: Adds titles and tags to images automatically. Titles are inferred from the prompt with an LLM, and tags from the image with a VLM or the ONNX tagger. Titles and tags set by people are never overwritten. All engines are disabled by default.
annotation.loadFailed: Could not load the automatic title and tag settings.
annotation.autoOnIngestLabel: Infer automatically when images are added
annotation.autoOnIngestHelp: Queues inference for every generated output, upload, and sketch.

enable.heading: Enable and run
enable.vlmHelp: For images without a prompt, the title is also inferred from the image.
enable.targetHelp: Choose where the LLM and VLM are sent, and which models, under “Usage” below.

usage.heading: Usage
usage.intro: For titles (LLM) and tags (VLM), choose an endpoint and a model name.
usage.externalNotice: When the LLM and VLM are enabled, prompts (LLM, VLM) and images downscaled to 1024px or less (VLM) are sent to the endpoints chosen here. With OpenAI, each call is billed.
usage.comfyuiHelp: Used only for images generated with ComfyUI. Can be set even when ComfyUI is not connected.
usage.vlmModelHelp: The tag model must accept image input.
usage.liteLlmExample: Relay servers such as LiteLLM: choose the same endpoint and change only the model name.
usage.ollamaExample: Ollama and similar: choose that endpoint and model under “ComfyUI images” so images made with ComfyUI are inferred there and other images use the default endpoint.
usage.comfyuiIsolation: When “ComfyUI images” uses a different endpoint, those images are never sent to the default endpoint, and failures do not fall back to the default.
usage.connectionsHelp: Add and edit endpoints and their keys under “LLM connections”.

language.heading: Language
language.tagLanguageLocalized: Match the language of titles and tags
language.tagLanguageHelp: When matching, the VLM writes tags in the language above and translations are added for the ONNX tagger's English tags (not when the language is English). Translations come from the same VLM call when the VLM is on, otherwise from the LLM. When left to each engine, every engine tags in its own language and nothing is translated.

limit.heading: Hourly limit
limit.hourlyLimitHelp: Number of LLM and VLM calls ({min} to {max}). Calls are counted per endpoint, and the same limit applies to every endpoint. When the limit is reached, inference waits until that endpoint has room instead of failing.
limit.hourlyLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}
limit.callsLastHourLabel: Calls in the last hour (all endpoints)
limit.perConnectionLabel: Calls in the last hour (per endpoint)
limit.perConnectionHelp: Shows the endpoints selected for auto titles and tags, and those called in the last hour.

onnx.heading: ONNX tagger (runs on this server)
onnx.notice: Adds tags with WD Tagger v3 (Apache-2.0). It is made for illustrations and does not suit photos. Tags are in English. Images are not sent anywhere. Models are downloaded from Hugging Face.
onnx.enabledLabel: Add tags with the ONNX tagger
onnx.modelHelp: Without a GPU, wd-swinv2-tagger-v3 (Base) is recommended. wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3 (Large) uses much more memory to load and takes several times longer per image. If free memory is below the estimate, the model is not loaded and the estimation fails.
onnx.modelNotDownloaded: The selected model cannot be used until it is downloaded.

deleteConfirm.message: Deletes the model "{name}". You will need to download it again to use it.

onnx.thresholdHelp: Only tags with a confidence at or above this value are added ({min} to {max}; default 0.35).

backfill.noEngines: Cannot run because no engine is available.
backfill.unsavedBlocked: You have unsaved changes. Save them before running.

message.one: Queues inference for {count} image that has never been inferred.
message.other: Queues inference for {count} images that have never been inferred.

confirm.warning: If the LLM or VLM uses OpenAI, you are billed per image.

contentRating.heading: Rating
contentRating.notice: Rates how sexually explicit an image is on five levels (Green, R, X, XX, XXX) with the WD Tagger model chosen under ONNX tagger. Images are not sent outside. It can be turned on independently of tagging with the ONNX tagger.
contentRating.enabledHelp: While on, every generated, uploaded or sketched image is rated when it is added.
contentRating.modelNotReady: Not available until the model chosen under ONNX tagger is downloaded.
contentRating.pendingLabel: Images not rated (including those rated with older rules)
contentRating.notUsable: Available after rating is turned on and saved and the model is downloaded.

message.one: Adds {count} image that has not been rated (or was rated with older rules) to the rating queue.
message.other: Adds {count} images that have not been rated (or were rated with older rules) to the rating queue.

embeddings.intro: Turns images into vectors with an embedding model (CLIP-style or EmbeddingGemma 2) for text search, similar images, and duplicate candidates.

enable.heading: Enable
enable.enabledHelp: While disabled, semantic search, "Similar images" in the viewer, and duplicate candidates are hidden.
enable.notUsable: Enabled, but not usable yet. Download the model, or set the connection and model name.

onnx.heading: Local model
onnx.notice: Images are not sent outside. Models are downloaded from Hugging Face.
onnx.englishOnlyNote: English-only model. Searching in Japanese rarely finds anything.
onnx.heavyNote: Higher search quality, but heavy to compute (each image takes tens of times longer than with CLIP).
onnx.modelHelp: clip-vit-b32-u8 is a light, fast model for English. To search in Japanese, choose clip-japanese-base or embeddinggemma-2-q8. embeddinggemma-2-q8 gives the best search quality, but computing images takes longer.
onnx.modelNotDownloaded: The selected model can't be used until it is downloaded.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete the files of model "{name}". Stored vectors are kept. You'll need to download it again to use it.

remote.heading: Remote inference server
remote.notice: Images (shrunk to 512px) and search text are sent to the selected connection.
remote.connectionHelp: Add, edit, and set keys for connections on this page:
remote.noConnections: No connection to choose. Add one in "LLM connections" first.
remote.modelHelp: The name of the model running on the inference server.
remote.sameSpaceNote: Changing the connection's Base URL keeps it as the same model. If the model behind it changes, delete its vectors under "Stored vectors" and compute them again.

errors.connectionUnknown: This connection no longer exists. Choose again

run.heading: Computing
run.autoOnIngestHelp: Computes vectors with the active model for every generation, upload, and sketch.
run.promptHelp: Vectors of the instructions (prompts) of generations and edits. They are computed with the same model as images and queued together by Compute all.
run.unsavedBlocked: You have unsaved changes. Save them before running.
run.notUsable: Can't run because no model is usable.

message.one: Add {count} image without vectors to the queue.
message.other: Add {count} images without vectors to the queue.

promptConfirm.one: Add the instruction (prompt) of {count} run without vectors to the queue.
promptConfirm.other: Add the instructions (prompts) of {count} runs without vectors to the queue.

duplicates.heading: Duplicate candidates
duplicates.thresholdHelp: The similarity threshold first used on the duplicate candidates page ({min}–{max}). Saved per model (the default for this model is {default}). It can be changed temporarily on that page.

stored.heading: Stored vectors
stored.help: Switching models keeps the previous model's vectors, so switching back needs no recomputing.

message.one: Delete {count} vector of "{name}". Using it again requires recomputing.
message.other: Delete {count} vectors of "{name}". Using it again requires recomputing.

comfyui.intro: Connecting to ComfyUI running on the same PC lets you pick registered workflows as a model (experimental).
comfyui.notConnectedHint: You can register workflows without connecting, but running them requires a connection.

timeout.label: Timeout (minutes)
timeout.help: The upper limit on waiting for one ComfyUI run. It applies from the next run that starts (running or queued Generated items are unaffected).
timeout.resetPending: Saving will reset this to the default ({default} min).

comfyui.workflowsHelp: Register workflows exported with "Export (API)" in ComfyUI to choose them as models.

sdwebui.intro: Connect to the API of Stable Diffusion WebUI (AUTOMATIC1111, Forge, etc.) to choose its checkpoints as models (experimental). Only generation (txt2img) is supported for now.

timeout.label: Timeout (minutes)
timeout.help: The upper limit on waiting for one SD WebUI run. It applies from the next run that starts (running or queued Generated items are unaffected).
timeout.resetPending: Saving will reset this to the default ({default} min).

tagDictionary.intro: Register CSV files of tags or translations to power prompt tag suggestions and tag translations. Dictionaries are shared by all users.
tagDictionary.schemeHelp: What the category numbers in a tag list mean. Choose "Danbooru" for Danbooru dictionaries and "Other" for dictionaries from other sites (numbers are kept as is).
tagDictionary.dropHint: You can also drop a file here. A CSV without a header (4 columns for a tag list, 2 for translations) or a zip of CSV files. Up to 100MB.

uploaded.one: Registered {count} dictionary. Until the import finishes, the previous dictionaries stay in use.
uploaded.other: Registered {count} dictionaries. Until the import finishes, the previous dictionaries stay in use.

tagDictionary.loadFailed: Could not load the tag dictionaries.
tagDictionary.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? The imported entries are removed too.

mcp.intro: Lets AI agents such as Claude Code use GAKEI generation and stock over MCP (Model Context Protocol). Runs created by agents are recorded in lineage and history just like runs created from this UI.
mcp.loadFailed: Could not load the MCP settings.
mcp.enabledTooltip: While disabled, agents cannot connect. Disabled by default.
mcp.limitTooltip: The number of runs that can be created through MCP in the last hour (0-{max}). Set it to 0 to stop generation through MCP. Read-only tools, such as browsing stock, remain available.
mcp.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}
mcp.limitStopped: The limit is 0, so generation through MCP is stopped.
mcp.runsLastHourLabel: Runs through MCP in the last hour
mcp.runsLastHourTooltip: The number of runs created through MCP. Once the limit is reached, new generation requests fail.
mcp.endpointTooltip: The URL to register in the agent. If agents connect from another PC, make sure it is reachable from there (PUBLIC_BASE_URL fixes it).
mcp.commandTokenNote: Replace <TOKEN> with a value each user issues under User settings > Access tokens.
mcp.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

mods.intro: Calls external systems or local code at set points (after ingest, before sending to AI, after generation).
mods.noticeExternal: Enabled Mods receive the user's information (ID, email, display name) and prompts. Webhooks with "Send images" also receive the images.
mods.noticePython: Python Mods run inside the GAKEI process with the same permissions as GAKEI. Enable only Mods whose code you have checked.
mods.loadFailed: Could not load the Mod settings

events.aiBeforeSend: before sending to an external AI

mods.waitForVerdictHelp: Called before the original is stored, and GAKEI waits for the reply. Uploads and generation finish later by that much.
mods.onFailureHelp: What to do when a pre-send check or a wait-for-verdict subscription fails or times out. "Block" is treated the same as a denial.

webhook.heading: Webhooks
webhook.help: Events are sent as JSON to the registered URL. Requests are signed with the key.
webhook.urlInvalid: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https:// (no user name or #)
webhook.secretHelp: Use a hard-to-guess key of at least {min} characters. The key is never shown, only whether it is set.
webhook.secretTooShort: The key is shorter than {min} characters. It still works, but replace it with a key of at least {min} characters.
webhook.sendImagesHelp: When on, the original images are sent along with the metadata.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete the webhook "{name}"? Its signing key is also removed.

test.heading: Send test: {name}
test.help: Sends one dummy event and shows the reply. It is not recorded in the call history.

python.heading: Python Mods
python.help: Mods placed in the server's Mod folder. They do nothing until enabled here, and are loaded when enabled.
python.empty: No Python Mods in the Mod folder
python.testNeedsEnabled: Enable it to send a test
python.pathHelp: A path on the GAKEI server.

order.heading: Call order
order.help: Pre-send checks are called in this order and stop at the first denial.

mods.instanceNameHelp: Sent as instance.name in events, so receivers can tell several GAKEI servers apart.

activity.deliveriesHelp: Events sent without waiting that could not be delivered even after retries.

locality.label: Connection type
locality.builtinNote: Same value as the OpenAI connection (changing either one changes both).
locality.loadFailed: Could not load the connection type

banner.missingKey: No OpenAI API key is set.
banner.missingKeyContactAdmin: No OpenAI API key is set. Please contact an admin.

shares.intro: Share links you created. Anyone with a link can view it without signing in. Revoking a link stops it from opening (this cannot be undone).
shares.loadFailed: Could not load your share links.
shares.empty: You have no share links. Create one with Share in the viewer.
shares.rootDeleted: The starting image was deleted, so this link does not open.
shares.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

revokeConfirm.message: Revoke this share link? The link will stop opening, and this cannot be undone.

shareAdmin.intro: Let users share images with links that need no sign-in. A link shows the images and their prompts and parameters (not who ran them, tags, or cost).
shareAdmin.enabledTooltip: While off, nobody can create share links and all existing links stop opening (the records stay, and links open again when you turn this back on). Off by default.
shareAdmin.loadFailed: Could not load the share link settings.

authentication.intro: Require sign-in and verify users with an OpenID Connect (OIDC) IdP. To turn it on, register a connection, save the admin emails, and then complete a test sign-in.
authentication.loadFailed: Could not load the authentication settings.
authentication.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
authentication.redirectUriHelp: Register this redirect URI on the client in your IdP.
authentication.envNote: Using the value from .env. Once you save here, the setting on this screen takes precedence.
authentication.resetPending: Saving reverts this to the .env / default value.

card.title: Connection
card.notConfiguredHelp: Create a client for GAKEI in your IdP, then register the issuer, client ID, and so on.
card.verifiedStale: The connection settings have changed. Run the test sign-in again.

pending.title: Pending connection
pending.help: When the test sign-in succeeds, this connection becomes active. Until then, the current connection stays in use.

test.waitingHelp: Sign in to your IdP in the popup. When it closes, the status is reloaded.
test.help: Signs in to your IdP in a popup. Use an account whose email is in the saved admin emails.
test.unsavedAdminEmails: Save your changes to the admin emails first (the test sign-in checks against the saved admin emails).
test.noAdminEmails: Enter and save the admin emails first.
test.otherOrigin: PUBLIC_BASE_URL ({url}) differs from the address of this page, so the result cannot reach this page. The status is reloaded after the popup closes.
test.popupBlocked: Could not open the popup. Allow popups for this site in your browser and try again.

errors.no_connection: There is no connection to test. Set up a connection first.
errors.callback_failed: Could not verify the response from the IdP. Check the registered redirect URI, client ID, and secret.
errors.email_missing: The IdP did not return an email address. Check that the scopes include email.
errors.email_unverified: The email address is not verified at the IdP.
errors.email_not_admin: The signed-in account's email is not in the saved admin emails.
errors.config_changed: The connection settings changed during the test. Run the test sign-in again.

dialog.title: Set up OIDC connection
dialog.intro: The connection you enter is registered as pending. The current connection does not change until the test sign-in succeeds.
dialog.issuerHelp: Verified by fetching /.well-known/openid-configuration under the issuer URL.
dialog.issuerChangeWarning: Changing the issuer makes existing users count as different people (their images and other data are not reassigned).
dialog.secretPlaceholderKeep: Leave blank to keep the current secret
dialog.noSecret: Do not use a secret (public client)
dialog.secretHelp: The secret is never shown on screen, even after saving.
dialog.publicBaseUrlHelp: The address users open GAKEI at in their browser. The redirect URI is built from it.
dialog.registered: Registered as pending. Register the redirect URI in your IdP, then run the test sign-in.
dialog.secretReentryRequired: The issuer's origin (scheme, host and port) changes, so the saved client secret is not sent. Enter the client secret again (for a public client, choose "Do not use a secret").

mode.label: Require sign-in (OIDC)
mode.help: When on, only people who signed in with the IdP can use GAKEI. When off (personal mode), anyone can use it without signing in.
mode.locked: Fixed by AUTH_MODE in .env and cannot be changed here (use it for emergency disabling).
mode.blockedSave: The conditions for turning this on are not met.

blockers.not_verified: Complete a test sign-in with the current connection
blockers.verified_email_not_admin: Include the test sign-in email ({email}) in the admin emails
blockers.pending_test: Complete a test sign-in with the pending connection

adminEmails.label: Admin emails
adminEmails.help: One per line (commas also work). People who sign in with these emails become admins.
adminEmails.empty: Enter at least one admin email.
adminEmails.selfMissing: You cannot save without your own email ({email}).

allowedDomains.label: Allowed sign-in domains
allowedDomains.help: One per line (e.g. example.com). Always set this for IdPs where anyone can create an account, such as Google. Admin emails can sign in even if their domain is not listed.
allowedDomains.emptyNote: While empty, anyone who can sign in to the IdP can use GAKEI.

sessionHours.label: Session length (hours)
sessionHours.help: How long until users need to sign in again ({min}–{max}).

disableConfirm.message: Turning off authentication lets anyone use GAKEI without signing in.
disableConfirm.warning: This is dangerous if the server is exposed to your LAN or the internet.

assistant.intro: Lets you chat in a panel next to the generation form to write prompts and prompt sets, and to hand off generation. Prompt sets written by the assistant can be restored from the result card.
assistant.loadFailed: Could not load the assistant settings.
assistant.enabledHelp: When enabled, an "Assistant" panel appears in the icon rail. Off by default.
assistant.connectionHelp: Choose a connection that supports tool calling and streaming. Reading attached images needs a model that accepts images.
assistant.modelHelp: The model name sent to the connection.
assistant.limitsIntro: Counted per user. When a limit is reached, requests are refused right away.

hourly_request_limit.label: LLM requests (per hour)
hourly_request_limit.help: LLM requests allowed in the last hour ({min}–{max}). Counted in the process and reset on restart.

runs_per_message_limit.label: Runs per message
runs_per_message_limit.help: Runs the assistant can create for one message ({min}–{max}). 0 stops generation by the assistant.

hourly_run_limit.label: Runs per hour

export.buttonTooltip: Download this image's lineage (originals and Generated records) as a ZIP
export.intro: Packs the original images in the lineage and the records of the Generated runs that made them (prompt, parameters, status) into a ZIP.

purposeHelp.import: The recipient can import it into their own GAKEI and keep editing.
purposeHelp.delivery: A record for someone who does not use GAKEI. Adds a page viewable in a browser (index.html) and a README.txt. It can still be imported into GAKEI.

scopeHelp.ancestors: Shows how a delivered image was made. Includes this image and the images it came from.
scopeHelp.descendants: Shows what a source image was used for. Includes this image and the images made from it, but not the images it came from.

export.previewFailed: Could not get the included images.

graphOmittedInputs.one: {count} input outside the scope is not included.
graphOmittedInputs.other: {count} inputs outside the scope are not included.

export.notIncluded: Titles, tags and groups are not included. Deleted images and other people's images are not included either.
export.includeCreatorNamesHelp: When on, the display name of the person who ran each Generated is included in the ZIP. Email addresses are never included.

import.tooltip: Import a lineage ZIP exported from GAKEI

importedRun.unverifiedNote: This Generated record was imported from a ZIP exported by another GAKEI (or another person); it was not run on this GAKEI. ZIP files can be modified, so its contents are unverified. It is not counted in costs.

regions.title: Regions
regions.buttonTitle: Draw boxes on the first input image and give each box a name or an instruction
regions.hint: Drag on the image to draw a box. Select a box to drag it from inside, and resize it with the corner and edge handles.
regions.empty: No boxes yet. Drag on the image to draw one.
regions.limitReached: You can add up to {max} boxes.

card.labelPlaceholder: What is in this box (e.g. the white cuff on the right hand)

instructionPlaceholder.change: How to change the inside of this box (e.g. make it a red hat)
instructionPlaceholder.add: What to add in this box (e.g. a white cat)

card.textPlaceholder: Text to draw, such as on a sign
card.moveHint: Moves what is in the dashed box (the original position) to the solid box (the target).
card.namedAreaHint: A box without an instruction is sent as a marker with only its location and name. Refer to it from the prompt as "Box {n}" or by its name.
card.chipsLabel: Insert a detected name into the instruction

problems.labelTooLong: Keep the name to {max} characters or fewer.
problems.textTooLong: Keep the text to draw within {max} characters.
problems.invalidBox: The box position is not valid. Draw it again.
problems.invalidSourceBox: The original-position box is not valid. Draw it again.

regions.saveBlocked: Fix the highlighted items to save.

notes.imageAndText: For OpenAI, an image with the boxes drawn on it is added to the inputs, and the instructions are added as text after the prompt. The model was not trained on boxes, so it may not always follow them.
notes.imageAndTextBlank: For OpenAI, a layout sketch with the boxes drawn on a blank canvas is sent as the input image through Edit, and the instructions are added as text after the prompt. The model was not trained on boxes, so it may not always follow them.
notes.countsTowardLimit: The boxes image and the reference images count toward the input image limit (up to {max}).
notes.comfyuiBboxes: For ComfyUI, the boxes are inserted into the workflow’s Create Bounding Boxes. The instruction (or the name, if there is none) becomes the box description, and text to draw makes it a text box. Only “Change” and “Add” can be used.

detection.heading: Detect
detection.intro: Uses a VLM to find objects in the image and shows candidate boxes (dashed). Click a candidate to make it a box.
detection.queryPlaceholder: e.g. cup, the clothes of the person on the left (empty finds the main objects)
detection.tallNote: For tall objects, the bottom edge often comes out short. Adjust the box before using it.
detection.historyDelete: Delete this detection from the history
detection.historyDeleteFailed: Could not delete it from the history.
detection.historyLoadFailed: Could not load the detection history.

regions.blankHint: There is no input image, so you draw on a blank canvas the size of the output (width × height). Boxes are kept as fractions of that size, so they stretch with it if you change the width or height. Adding an input image removes these boxes.
